annotations.title: Details of a boat on Boatopoly

description: Returns the details of one boat for sale on Boatopoly: price, dimensions, year, engines, equipment notes, the description (in the language of the conversation when the seller has one), photos and the link to the advert. Give the advert number (e.g. 30012) or the link that search_boats returned. The buyer contacts the seller on the advert page; this tool sends no message.

boat.description: The advert number (e.g. "30012") or the link of the advert.

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl), Latvian (lv), Swedish (sv), Portuguese (pt), Danish (da), Norwegian (no), Finnish (fi), Greek (el), Turkish (tr), Hungarian (hu) or Slovak (sk) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

name: get_boat
title: Details of a boat on Boatopoly
